focus_areas.label: Locality, Bell assumptions, and statistical independence
focus_areas.description: Analyze which assumptions force Bell-type conclusions and how locally causal models can violate statistical independence without confusing correlation with superluminal causation.

focus_areas.label: Measurement problem and physical wavefunction collapse
focus_areas.description: Distinguish interpretations from dynamical extensions and identify what a model must actually explain to count as a solution of the measurement problem.

focus_areas.label: Superdeterminism, fine-tuning, overfitting, and testability
focus_areas.description: Treat fine-tuning claims operationally, distinguish broad model classes from restricted examples, and prioritize experimentally discriminating predictions.

focus_areas.label: Quantum gravity and local collapse
focus_areas.description: Explore whether constraints arising from a deeper matter-geometry theory can yield effective local collapse dynamics with testable consequences.

routing_rule: Load only the focus areas materially relevant to the current question; do not assume every historical research topic is current priority.
